Mira (PM): Quick triage: customers asking for two things: a trimmed on-prem installer for low-disk racks, and a non-disruptive upgrade path that preserves egress IPs. decide sprint scope?
Dev (Eng): Short list of must-haves?
Mira (PM): 1) installer tarball that supports preloaded images and --dry-run; 2) upgrade flow with pause/resume and a documented manual NAT translation if automatic preservation isn't possible.
Sam (Field Eng): For the installer, gates: offline helm apply on 2-node lab, tarball sha256, and a one-page field runbook. I can validate.
Olga (SRE): Upgrade gates: preflight checks, ability to pause within 10m, and a rollback that doesn't require DB restore. Add telemetry event for "egress-change".
Ken (CS): Two paying pilots; recommend prioritizing the installer first to unblock pilots and ship the runbook for upgrades as v1.
Mira (PM): Proposal: split sprint: 65% installer, 35% upgrade runbook + preflight. Action: Dev spike PR EOW, Sam lab test Thu, Olga draft preflight checklists, Ken coordinate pilot windows.
ops-bot: CI queued: packaging/compact-installer #8123 -> queued.
Dev (Eng): ack.
Sam (Field Eng): ack.
Olga (SRE): ack.
